Pilot your Submersible Hydrodynamic Research Integrated Marine Platform (SHRIMP), master the six elemental classes with powerful fusion abilities , and unlock specialized SHRIMP Platforms each with their own unique strengths and personalities. Explore the sunken ruins solo or in 6-player co-op, or KRILL your friends in chaotic PvP modes like Shrimp Royale, Shrimp Tag, and Boss Mode! "Okay... This is ****** awesome..." - Iron Pineapple "I think this actually... This is really good." - Vinny Vinesauce Battle massive bosses of the deep from volcano-bound hermit crabs to kaiju-sized electric eels Face swarms of aquatic fauna like murderous betta fish, dangerous dust crabs, and hostile sea sponges Fight and SHRIMP together across the entire campaign in multiplayer co-op up to 6 pilots Krill your friends in PVP with games such Royale, Tag, and Boss Mode! Choose from 6 base elemental powers with the potential to create 2 dozen different element fusions like Magma, Smog, Moon, Demon, and Bone to complement your build Pick from 11 different Submersible Hydrodynamic Research Integrated Marine Platforms (SHRIMP) each with their own different strengths and play styles Customize your build with over 2 dozen weapons from heavy cannon shots, shotgun blasts, or machine-gun projectiles with added stat upgrades and rarities Explore and perhaps restore an underwater realm on the brink of destruction Discover ancient ruins, complete puzzles hiding treasures, and traverse cryptic domains Meet and help a variety of eccentric and interesting characters each with their own motivations Travel the depths with a watery Drum N' Bass inspired soundtrack with over a dozen songs

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
SHRIMP GAME: KRILL CONFIRMED is an atmospheric third-person looter shooter RPG set in a decaying underwater world replete with horrific sea creatures and Lovecraftian Bosses.
Pilot your Submersible Hydrodynamic Research Integrated Marine Platform (SHRIMP), master the six elemental classes with powerful fusion abilities, and unlock specialized SHRIMP Platforms each with their own unique strengths and personalities.
Explore the sunken ruins solo or in 6-player co-op, or KRILL your friends in chaotic PvP modes like Shrimp Royale, Shrimp Tag, and Boss Mode!

  • "Okay... This is ****** awesome..." - Iron Pineapple

  • "I think this actually... This is really good." - Vinny Vinesauce

  • Battle massive bosses of the deep from volcano-bound hermit crabs to kaiju-sized electric eels

  • Face swarms of aquatic fauna like murderous betta fish, dangerous dust crabs, and hostile sea sponges

  • Fight and SHRIMP together across the entire campaign in multiplayer co-op up to 6 pilots

  • Krill your friends in PVP with games such Royale, Tag, and Boss Mode!

  • Choose from 6 base elemental powers with the potential to create 2 dozen different element fusions like Magma, Smog, Moon, Demon, and Bone to complement your build

  • Pick from 11 different Submersible Hydrodynamic Research Integrated Marine Platforms (SHRIMP) each with their own different strengths and play styles

  • Customize your build with over 2 dozen weapons from heavy cannon shots, shotgun blasts, or machine-gun projectiles with added stat upgrades and rarities

  • Explore and perhaps restore an underwater realm on the brink of destruction

  • Discover ancient ruins, complete puzzles hiding treasures, and traverse cryptic domains 

  • Meet and help a variety of eccentric and interesting characters each with their own motivations

  • Travel the depths with a watery Drum N' Bass inspired soundtrack with over a dozen songs
